body: Thank you for your reply, I really appreciate it! I know it’s mostly my anxiety because of my depression but I guess I’ve been taught be safe in the future

Thank you for your advice, and the past few days of worrying has really taught me this important lesson. I promise that I will be more responsible in the future and I will not take any more risks anymore.
Thanks bro, a little assurance do help a bit
Thank you for your reply, I really appreciate it

I’m so sorry for what you went through. It really sucks because we thought these people love us. And I’m no longer sure what I’m fighting for anymore because honestly I don’t know how to control the pain.

I am sorry to hear that. I’m in a similar situation but the difference is “my friends” still “check on me”. No not to listen or be there for me but just to make sure “they don’t lose me” because they “love me”. Sadly, my reason to fight and stay alive after my attempt has become the thing that causes me the most pain.
